source_byte_ranges.label: native eager-file invalidation and hook cause
native Ctn, pT, obo, sbo, nrt and ibo

substitutions.aLn: Event-controlled asynchronous file traversal; snapshots the supplied file array at invocation, with explicit completion or rejection.
substitutions.yLn: Event-controlled asynchronous context loader using actual native qb; fixture opaque blocks and file descriptors substitute account/project/plugin acquisition and instruction rendering.
substitutions.feature_state: U_t and B_t are deterministic per-root callback subscriptions; actual native sbo/nrt select causes and invalidate caches.
substitutions.external_effects: Classifier publication, project cache purge, account project-detail purge and plugin telemetry are recorded callbacks; unrelated prefetch and helper registration are no-ops.
substitutions.timing: Explicit completion events and Promise microtasks only; no sleeps, clocks, provider calls, subprocesses or filesystem traversal.

execution.identity_observations: Promise and descriptor identity booleans are reference evidence. Portable cache tests can compare payloads, build counts, reasons, root isolation and recorded effects.
